name: codereins-bridge
description: Local, token-protected control channel that lets the codereins command drive this window.

codereinsBridge.enabled.description: Start the local control channel in every window. Turn off to stop codereins from driving VS Code.

codereinsBridge.allowEval.description: Allow `codereins bridge eval` to run arbitrary JavaScript against the extension API. User settings only; a workspace cannot turn this on.
